title: Red bacteria
subtitle: Two genes, one pigment
objective: Assemble a two-gene circuit: each gene needs its own landing strip for the ribosome.
objective_es: Monta un circuito de dos genes: cada gen necesita su propia pista de aterrizaje para el ribosoma.
description: Making a pigment often needs more than one enzyme, so more than one gene. In bacteria, each gene of the circuit has its own ribosome site.
description_es: Fabricar un pigmento suele necesitar más de una enzima, así que más de un gen. En bacterias, cada gen del circuito tiene su propio sitio para el ribosoma.

organism.description: A bacterium that makes a red pigment.
organism.description_es: Una bacteria que fabrica un pigmento rojo.

exploration.label: Pigment
exploration.title: A chain of enzymes
exploration.description: The red of tomatoes, lycopene, is made by a short chain of enzymes. Bacteria with the same genes also turn red.
exploration.description_es: El rojo de los tomates, el licopeno, lo fabrica una cadena corta de enzimas. Las bacterias con los mismos genes también se vuelven rojas.

exploration.label: Two genes
exploration.title: One after the other
exploration.description: Genes placed one after the other under the same promoter are read together, but each needs its own landing strip.
exploration.description_es: Los genes colocados uno tras otro bajo el mismo promotor se leen juntos, pero cada uno necesita su pista de aterrizaje.

parts.label: Inducible promoter
parts.description: Switches on when the chemical is added.
parts.description_es: Se enciende cuando se añade el compuesto.

parts.label: Switched-off promoter
parts.description: A promoter that is never switched on here.
parts.description_es: Un promotor que aquí nunca se enciende.
parts.wrongReason: This promoter is never switched on in this culture, so no pigment would be made.
parts.wrongReason_es: Este promotor nunca se enciende en este cultivo, así que no se fabricaría pigmento.

parts.label: RBS 1
parts.description: Landing strip for the first gene.
parts.description_es: Pista de aterrizaje para el primer gen.

parts.label: First pigment gene
parts.description: Recipe for the first enzyme of the chain.
parts.description_es: Receta de la primera enzima de la cadena.

parts.label: RBS 2
parts.description: Landing strip for the second gene.
parts.description_es: Pista de aterrizaje para el segundo gen.

parts.label: Second pigment gene
parts.description: Recipe for the second enzyme of the chain.
parts.description_es: Receta de la segunda enzima de la cadena.

parts.label: gfp gene
parts.description: Recipe for a green fluorescent protein.
parts.description_es: Receta de una proteína verde fluorescente.
parts.wrongReason: gfp makes a protein that glows green. It is not part of the red pigment chain.
parts.wrongReason_es: gfp fabrica una proteína que brilla en verde. No forma parte de la cadena del pigmento rojo.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: Both pigment genes go between the promoter and the terminator, and each gene needs its own landing strip before it.
hints.content_es: Los dos genes del pigmento van entre el promotor y el terminador, y cada gen necesita su propia pista de aterrizaje antes.

hints.title: Next step
hints.content: Use the promoter that can be switched on and leave out gfp, which makes something else.
hints.content_es: Usa el promotor que se puede encender y deja fuera gfp, que fabrica otra cosa.

hints.title: Solution
hints.content: Promoter → RBS 1 → first gene → RBS 2 → second gene → terminator.
hints.content_es: Promotor → RBS 1 → primer gen → RBS 2 → segundo gen → terminador.

completion.title: A two-step pigment
completion.summary: You assembled two genes in a row, each with its own landing strip, to make a pigment in two steps.
completion.summary_es: Has montado dos genes seguidos, cada uno con su pista de aterrizaje, para fabricar un pigmento en dos pasos.
completion.realWorldImpact: Microbes are being engineered to make natural dyes and pigments for food and textiles.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: Se modifican microbios para fabricar colorantes y pigmentos naturales para alimentos y textiles.

science.realWorldCase: Researchers have made E. coli produce lycopene and related pigments by adding genes from other organisms.
science.realWorldCase_es: Los investigadores han hecho que E. coli produzca licopeno y pigmentos parecidos añadiéndole genes de otros organismos.
science.scientificContext: Genes arranged one after another under a single promoter and read together are called an operon, a common arrangement in bacteria.
science.scientificContext_es: Los genes dispuestos uno tras otro bajo un solo promotor y leídos juntos forman un operón, una disposición frecuente en bacterias.
gameplaySimplifications: Real pathways for pigments can have many more steps and genes.
gameplaySimplifications_es: Las rutas reales de los pigmentos pueden tener muchos más pasos y genes.
